reader_summary.overview: Bull Market Rhymes While I employ a great many adages and quotes in my writings, my main go-to list consists of a relatively small number. One of my favorites is widely attributed to Mark Twain. History doesn't repeat itself, but it does rhyme.

thesis: The speaker argues that investment history does not repeat itself but rhymes, specifically through recurring behavioral cycles of excesses and corrections driven by investor psychology. He defines a real bull market not by percentage price movements but by an upward spiral where favorable developments and rising prices fuel aggressive behavior and risk-taking, noting that recent events from 2020 to 2021 exemplified this classic bull market psychology.
